name: Dorayaki
description: Two fluffy honey pancakes sandwiched together with a generous filling of sweet azuki red bean paste.
ingredients: a handful of grated fresh ginger
a handful of fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with neutral vegetable oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the ramen noodles and cracked black pepper until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the soy sauce with the water until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 20 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with chives or a dusting of sake.
tips: This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
